title: Scale-Up Evaluation Trial of the Diabetes Prevention Program to Improve Obesity and Cardiometabolic Health After Traumatic Brain Injury
official: Scale-Up Evaluation Trial of the Diabetes Prevention Program to Improve Obesity and Cardiometabolic Health After Traumatic Brain Injury
summary: The Investigators have proposed targeted efforts to address the feasibility, effectiveness, fidelity, and evaluation of the GLB-TBI Evidence Based Intervention (EBI) in a real world setting at a CDC-recognized site

interventions.name: Group Lifestyle Balance for People with TBI (GLB-TBI)

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18-80 years of age

  -≥6 months post-TBI
* Moderate to severe TBI at time of injury
* BMI ≥25 kg/m2
* Able to communicate in English

Exclusion Criteria:

* Contraindications to physical activity
* Low cognitive function
* Residing in hospital, acute rehab, SNF
* Self-Reported Pregnancy
* Pre-existing diagnosis of an eating disorder
* Former DPP-GLB Participants (less than 6months since participation ended)
